accountLimits.videoTooBig: That clip is over 95 MB. Trim it or lower its quality, then try again.
accountLimits.fileTooBig: That file is over 95 MB. Make it smaller, then try again.
accountLimits.wrongType: Fuobe takes PNG, JPEG or WebP pictures, MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV or AVI clips, and MP3, WAV, OGG, FLAC or M4A sound.

accountLimits.filesFull: Your files have reached 5 GB. Delete some runs to make room.
accountLimits.uploadRate: That's a lot of uploads at once. Try again in a few minutes.
accountLimits.uploadsBusy: Lots of uploads right now. Try again in a moment.
accountLimits.uploadStalled: The upload stopped arriving. Check your connection, then try again.
accountLimits.diskLow: Uploads will be ready again in a moment — please try once more shortly.
accountLimits.activeRuns: You have 4 runs going. Start the next one when one finishes.
accountLimits.waitingRuns: You have 4 runs waiting for your GPU. Cancel one, or run one with your key, to start another.
accountLimits.runRate: You've made a lot this hour — your next runs are ready in a little while.
accountLimits.finishRate: You've finished a lot of pictures this hour — more are ready in a little while.
accountLimits.finishBusy: Your last pictures are still being saved. Try again in a moment.
accountLimits.outputsCapped: Each run makes up to 4 results.
accountLimits.bodyTooBig: That's too large to send. Try a smaller file.
accountLimits.gpuChecks: Give it a minute, then check again.
accountLimits.probeRate: Too many clip checks at once. Wait a moment, then try again.
accountLimits.reloadToUpload: Reload the page, then upload again.
accountLimits.lengthNeeded: That upload didn't go through. Please try again.
accountLimits.zipTooMany: Download up to 200 at a time.
accountLimits.zipTooBig: That's over 1 GB. Download fewer items at a time.
accountLimits.zipBusy: Your last download is still going. Try again when it finishes.
